_comment: Curated market-events calendar for the homepage Market Pulse header. Owner-maintained, like macro-context.json. Loaded into Supabase market_events by market_pulse.py. Update once a year when the official schedules are published (MSCI/FTSE review calendars, Bank Indonesia RDG schedule, Fed FOMC dates, BPS advance-release calendar). Dates verified against official 2026 schedules as of 2026-05.
